_comment: POST-CHECKPOINT EXECUTION CONTRACT. Frozen 2026-09-21. The executing agent makes NO decisions during recovery: every value it needs is stated here or in the baseline. Any deviation is a STOP, not a judgement call.

blocked_until.checkpoint_rule: the FIRST APPLICABLE CLEANUP SWEEP AFTER that moment — not the moment itself
blocked_until.note: No rebuild may start before this resolves. A pre-checkpoint rebuild multiplies exposure if KEEP does not hold.

control.when: BEFORE the first rebuild and AFTER every single recovery

recovery_order.rationale: configuration twin of the proven control

excluded.instruction: DO NOT REBUILD. Deletion is not authorized either; P0-4 has its own gate.

execution_rule: ONE service at a time. rebuild -> run all 9 assertions -> re-verify control -> STOP on any failure. Do not batch. Do not proceed to order N+1 until order N is completely green.

assertions.text: the new revision carries 100% of traffic

assertions.note: the P0-3 result; already minInstanceCount=0 at the function layer, so the rebuild MATERIALISES it rather than setting it

assertions.text: the new image digest is present in Artifact Registry
the previously stuck failed revision is no longer latestCreatedRevisionName and is therefore deletable
FULL STRUCTURAL EQUALITY of the trigger specification, pre vs post
assertions.method: compare baseline entry `raw` against a fresh describe, after deterministic key ordering only. NO field may be selected away, added, removed, changed or silently normalised. A rebuild must reproduce the trigger CONTRACT, not something resembling it.
assertions.applies: all six; DECISIVE for onOrderStatusChange and onNewOrderCreated

assertions.text: memory, cpu, timeout, concurrency, ingress and service account match the baseline exactly

assertions.note: exact equality, not approximate. A creation, deletion or name collision FAILS the gate.

assertions.text: the control (profilegetpublicprofile) still satisfies every condition in `control.must_hold`

authorization.note: This manifest is a contract, not a permission. Each execution step needs its own authorization.
